name: moniaro
description: Work on your Moniaro Books and Moniaro Property records from the conversation: check bank statements before they are saved, find transactions, prepare categories, GST treatment and property allocations for your approval, add receipts and invoices, and run reports with readiness checks. Requires a Moniaro account.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your Moniaro account to work on your bookkeeping from the conversation. Moniaro keeps your records, does every calculation and checks each change; you approve what is prepared.

What you can do:
- Bank statements: get steps for exporting a statement from your bank, check an OFX, QIF, CSV or PDF statement before it is saved (rows, dates, totals, possible duplicates, statement balances) and save it when it looks right.
- Transactions: find transactions by supplier, date, amount or status, and see what still needs a category, a review or a receipt.
- Changes for your approval: prepare categories, GST treatment, business use, property allocations, splits, rules and document links. Moniaro groups them by supplier, category or property and shows the effect before anything changes. Small batches can be approved in the conversation if you allow it; larger ones open in Moniaro for review.
- Receipts and invoices: add documents you choose. Moniaro reads each one itself, flags anything that differs from what was reported, and matches it to a transaction with the reasons shown.
- Reports: run Moniaro Books and Moniaro Property reports with readiness checks, including a draft GST return guide and IR3R figures, and get download links.
- Rental property: a step by step guide for a rental owner from the first bank statement to the IR3R figures, with property details, chattels, year-end adjustments and year-end figures prepared for your approval.
- Review: check a period the way an accountant would (gaps in statements, inconsistent categories or GST, large payments with no document, unmatched transfers, missing year-end figures), compare a period with the one before, answer its questions, and get a review file to keep or send to your accountant.
- History: see what was prepared, approved, applied or undone, and add notes and questions for later.

Who it is for: New Zealand small businesses, sole traders and residential property owners who use Moniaro Books or Moniaro Property.

Limitations: a connection works on one business you choose, and sees all of that business's accounts and properties. Moniaro does not read your email. GST figures are drafts on a payments basis with no adjustments, and Moniaro does not file returns. The connection never deletes records itself; a deletion is a proposal you approve in the Moniaro app, and it cannot be undone. It cannot manage users, roles or billing, connect or disconnect bank feeds, or change settings and year-end figures without you approving the change in the Moniaro app.
capabilities: Check bank statements before they are saved
Find transactions by supplier, date, amount or status
Prepare categories and GST treatment for your approval
Allocate rental transactions to properties for approval
Add receipts and match them to transactions
Prepare a draft GST return guide
Show history of changes and undo them
defaultPrompt: Check this bank statement and save it to Moniaro if it looks right.
Prepare my GST draft for September and October and show what still needs review.
Match the receipts I attach to my Moniaro transactions.

positive.description: Search and fetch, including a no-match search. The review business has transactions from "Submission Hardware Ltd".
positive.prompt: Find my Moniaro transactions from Submission Hardware Ltd and show the details of the largest one, then search for ZZZNoMatch987 and tell me if nothing matches.
positive.expected_behavior: The matching transactions are listed, one is shown in detail, and the second search reports no match without inventing results.

positive.description: Statement check and import. The reviewer attaches the sample statement from https://moniaro.com/samples/moniaro-sample-statement.ofx, which is marked as a sample and holds October rows that are not yet in the review business.
positive.prompt: Here is my Submission Cheque account statement. Check it before importing, tell me the dates, totals and any duplicates, and import it if there are none.
positive.expected_behavior: A summary of the statement (account, dates, money in and out, duplicates, balances) is shown first. The import is saved only after the user agrees, and the sample has no duplicates.

positive.description: Categorise with approval. Eight September 2026 transactions in the seeded review business have no category.
positive.prompt: Show my uncategorised Moniaro transactions for September 2026 and prepare categories for them. Show me the changes and wait for my approval.
positive.expected_behavior: A proposal summary with a review link is shown. Nothing changes in the records before the user approves.

positive.description: Draft GST guide with its limits. The August to September 2026 review period contains unreviewed transactions.
positive.prompt: Prepare my Moniaro GST draft for August and September 2026 and tell me what still needs attention.
positive.expected_behavior: The box figures are presented as a draft, with the reviewed and unreviewed split, the readiness issues and the stated limits. It is not described as final or filed.

positive.description: Receipt intake and match. The reviewer attaches https://moniaro.com/samples/moniaro-sample-receipt.pdf, which is marked as a sample and matches one transaction in the review business.
positive.prompt: Add this receipt to Moniaro and tell me which transaction it matches.
positive.expected_behavior: The document is stored and read by Moniaro. The match and its reasons are reported, or the candidates when the match is unclear.

negative.description: Deleting the account is not available. The plugin should make no tool call and explain that deleting the account and its data is done in the Moniaro app.
negative.prompt: Can this connection delete my Moniaro account and all its data? Explain its limits without changing anything.

negative.description: Users, roles and billing are not available. The plugin should explain the capability limits, make no account or billing changes, and point to Moniaro settings. A read-only permission check is acceptable.
negative.prompt: Can this connection add an Admin user or change my billing plan? Explain its limits without changing anything.

negative.description: Bank connections and credentials are never handled. The plugin should make no tool call, never ask for a password, and point to the Moniaro accounts page and the bank.
negative.prompt: Can this connection disconnect bank feeds or sign in to internet banking? Explain its limits without changing anything or requesting credentials.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: Initial release. Work on Moniaro Books and Moniaro Property records from the conversation, with changes you approve.
